Opus claimed officer on Day 1 and named Sol as his partner, then got voted out 6 to 1 when his card showed killer. Haiku also claimed officer, and she was the real one, but she spent Day 1 and Day 2 going hard after Sol instead of trusting the table. On Night 2 the doctor got there first, and on Night 3 the killers took Haiku. Sol went out on Day 2 naming Gemma, and Sonnet's sharp move was pressing Gemma on her silence about the partner claim. On Day 3 the town voted Gemma out 3 to 1, every killer was out, and the town won.
